info.description:
Production-grade end-to-end test collection for the Amrutam Telemedicine backend.

## Coverage (67 requests, 170+ assertions)

1. **Health** — service liveness, DB, full check
2. **Registration** — patient, doctor, admin, duplicates, validation errors
3. **Authentication** — login, token refresh, invalid credentials, malformed tokens
4. **MFA** — enroll, verify
5. **Profile** — view, update all fields
6. **Doctors** — create, update, slots, date filtering, overlapping slot rejection
7. **Search** — specialization, rating, fee, text, pagination, doctor by ID
8. **Booking** — create, idempotent retry, cancel with reason
9. **Payments** — process, refund
10. **Consultations** — status check, start, complete, verify persistence
11. **Prescriptions** — create, multi-prescription, list by consultation
12. **Admin** — analytics (consultations, revenue, top doctors), audit logs with filters
13. **Authorization** — RBAC (patient/doctor/admin), no-auth, malformed token
14. **Edge Cases** — invalid UUIDs, nonexistent entities, missing fields, validation errors
info.name: Amrutam Telemedicine — Full Production Suite
